coverage: u64 membership per pixel for up to 8x8 samples; paint and all clipping paths intersect individual bits before conversion to alpha; unclipped u8 coverage path preserved

qualification.scope: authored open/closed axis-aligned clip boundaries, nested intersection, empty clip, eoclip hole, save/restore and initclip

invariants: clip nodes and records admitted to shared budget

preflight counts clip traversal and composite work before RGBA allocation
subpixel identical clip is idempotent and disjoint clips have zero coverage for samples 1 through 8
cancellation discards output and releases temporary budget
gsave/grestore retains previous clipping branch and current path
limits: independent curved/diagonal clipping and broad producer corpus remain unqualified
default Ghostscript fill-adjust and antialias differences remain recorded by existing strict gates
